jobs.title: Senior CAD Engineer – Physical Verification
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain physical verification tools, flows, and methodologies for DRAM, HBM, NAND, and emerging memory products.
* Develop, debug, qualify, and release Siemens Calibre design rule checking (DRC) and layout versus schematic (LVS) rule decks using Standard Verification Rule Format (SVRF).
* Translate process design rules into verification checks, and define the test cases, coverage criteria, and regression methods that qualify them.
* Partner with process, design, layout, modeling, and verification teams to define signoff strategies and resolve verification issues.
* Guide design teams on verification methodologies, waivers, and debugging, and provide training, documentation, and production support.
* Evaluate EDA technologies that improve verification quality, performance, and capacity.
* Automate verification setup, execution, and reporting, including AI-assisted analysis and debugging.
* Lead technical projects and contribute to the physical verification roadmap.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 5+ years of industry experience in **CAD, EDA,** or **semiconductor design.**
* Experience with DRC and LVS **physical verification**, IC layout, and process design rules.
* Ability to interpret design-rule requirements and resolve complex verification issues in production flows.
* Proficiency in **Python** and at least one additional language, such as SKILL, Tcl, Perl, C, or C++, plus Linux/Unix and shell scripting.
* **Solid CMOS and VLSI fundamentals**, with clear communication and practical debugging skills across global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience developing and qualifying Calibre DRC and LVS rule decks in SVRF, using nmDRC, nmLVS, and Results Viewing Environment (RVE).
* Knowledge of layout-dependent effects and electrical rule checking (ERC), programmable ERC (PERC), antenna, and density checks.
* Experience optimizing rule-deck coverage, runtime, and memory use.
* Experience with Cadence Virtuoso, SKILL, or Cadence physical verification tools.
* Experience applying AI/ML, large language models, or agentic AI to engineering workflows.
* Experience with source control, automated testing, and release management.
* Knowledge of DRAM, HBM, NAND, or emerging memory development.

$104,000.00 - $221,000.00 a year

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Identity Data Science
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit’s Identity Data Science Team is looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist who is a creative problem solver with a passion to deliver advanced data-driven solutions. You will work alongside other Data Scientists, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Architects, and Program Managers to evolve Intuit’s Identity capabilities within Intuit’s Platform. As a key member of the data science team, you will have a strong track record of combining advanced analytical skills with exceptional business and entrepreneurial acumen. You will also have an ownership mindset with a strong willingness to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.

This is an exciting time to join the Identity Data Science Team at Intuit as we are building many new cutting-edge capabilities. These include a next-generation Verified Identity Network, password-less authentication powered through passkeys, Generative AI experiences, modern and sophisticated fraud prevention, centralized user and account management, and much more. Data is central to Intuit’s decision-making process, and data scientists are a critical component to evangelize data-driven decisions as we transform and scale Identity capabilities to power Intuit’s future growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with cross functional teams to drive data-backed decisions and actionable insights
* Use a hypothesis-driven approach to drive design, implementation, and analysis of A/B experiments. Then provide executive level recommendations on next steps based on the test results and insights
* Communicate analytical findings and recommendations in a clear and concise way to non-technical audiences, both in writing and through oral presentations
* Provide guidance and thought leadership to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data to support business goals
* Ensure data collection and data processing is optimized to provide crystal-clear visibility into the impact and value of new initiatives and product releases
* Identify opportunities for developing new data sources, and provide technical leadership around making those data sources high-quality and broadly available
* Pursue data quality, troubleshoot data anomalies, validate data accuracy, and drive issues to resolution
* Share responsibility for owning and maintaining the data science backlog, connecting directly with partners and stakeholders to communicate and align on priorities

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience working in web, marketing, product, analytics, or other related data science fields with a strong knowledge of statistics
* Exceptional SQL skills and experience working with granular web and native clickstream data
* Highly proficient in Tableau, Qliksense, Quicksight or similar software
* Exceptional ability to take initiative, be a self-starter, and solve problems
* Outstanding communications skills with the ability to influence decision makers and build consensus with stakeholder teams
* Proactive and inquisitive learner who seeks out and capitalizes on opportunities for change that enhance the business, rather than reacting to circumstances
* Strong organizational skills, time management, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines
* Love for mentoring and guiding others on best practices. Passionate about the advancement of the whole team
* Experience in programming languages, automation tools, and stats packages (e.g. Python) is a plus; comfortable creating re-usable data pipelines

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
San Diego $149,500 - $202,500

jobs.title: Research Lab Technician II
jobs.description:
The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Titus Family Department of Clinical Pharmacy, is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to support ongoing studies in immunogenomics, cancer genomics and therapeutics.

We are a translational genomics and experimental therapeutics lab focused on identifying and investigating novel therapeutic targets in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and developing new therapeutic strategies. We seek a highly motivated, detail-oriented individual to perform molecular, cellular, and in vivo experiments and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Process, bank, and track clinical samples (e.g., blood and bone marrow) according to established protocols and regulatory requirements
* Perform routine molecular biology techniques, including DNA/RNA extraction, PCR/qPCR, Western blotting, and preparation of samples and libraries for next-generation sequencing
* Maintain cell lines and primary cell cultures; perform cell-based assays, including flow cytometry and high-throughput drug screening
* Assist with preclinical studies in leukemia mouse models, including colony maintenance, dosing, monitoring, and tissue collection
* Perform basic data analysis and assist with bioinformatic workflows under the guidance of senior lab members
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, sample databases, and inventory; order supplies and reagents
* Ensure compliance with biosafety, IACUC, and IRB protocols; maintain equipment and a safe, organized lab environment
* Prepare figures and summaries of results for lab meetings and contribute to manuscripts under the direction of the Principal Investigator

**Minimum Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology, or a related field
* Hands-on laboratory experience with routine molecular biology and cell culture techniques
* Excellent organizational, record-keeping, and communication skills
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Master’s degree or 1–2 years of research laboratory experience
* Experience with flow cytometry, NGS sample preparation, or high-throughput assays
* Experience with mouse handling and in vivo studies
* Familiarity with basic data analysis tools (e.g., R, Python, GraphPad Prism) or interest in learning bioinformatics
* Background in cancer biology or hematologic malignancies

**Applicants should include the following:**

  

* Cover letter describing research experience and interests
* Résumé or CV
* Names and contact information for two to three references

The hourly rate range for this position is $26.00 - $28.32. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  
Minimum Education: Associate's degree, Specialized/technical training, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Field of Expertise: Working knowledge of laboratory equipment and research protocols. Knowledge of computer analysis techniques and ability to provide routine analysis and interpretation of research data.

jobs.title: Sr. Research Associate, Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
The Senior Research Associate independently executes complex research and development activities supporting the development and characterization of the company’s cell therapy programs. Working with minimal supervision, this role performs and optimizes translational and molecular biology workflows, analyzes and interprets experimental data, troubleshoots technical challenges, and contributes to experimental planning and method development. The position collaborates with R&D and cross-functional teams and serves as a technical resource in support of project and research objectives.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Independently execute and optimize single cell and single nucleus RNA sequencing workflows, including cell thawing and counting, sample preparation, library preparation, library quality control, and preparation of libraries for sequencing.
* Execute molecular biology and biomarker assay workflows including nucleic acid isolation, PCR, qPCR, sequencing related assays, and sample preparation and processing for LC-MS based analyses.
* Support cell culture workflows and perform other research and development activities in collaboration with R&D scientists and cross-functional partners.
* Make detailed observations; compile, analyze, and interpret experimental and sequencing data; assess data quality; summarize conclusions; and communicate findings to supervisors and the broader R&D team.

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The Department of Anatomy and Neurobiology is a world-leading neuroscience department where discoveries at the molecular, anatomical, and physiological levels are seamlessly integrated to the development of new treatments for neurological diseases.
  
  
The Jung laboratory studies neuroinflammation, neurodegeneration, and related neurological disorders in mouse models, integrating animal experimentation, molecular and cellular assays, behavioral testing, imaging, and data analysis.

  
  
Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Research Associate- Analytical Chemistry
jobs.description:
**Research Associate- Analytical Chemistry**

**About the Company**

Sapho Bio is the developer of a rapid microbiology release platform for precision medicine. We are a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers committed to transforming pharmaceutical release testing through innovation, speed, and accuracy. We are a team built on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, scaling rapidly following product validation and commercial traction. Our culture emphasizes agency, innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continual learning.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a meticulous and dependable Research Associate. You will work directly with our fleet of HPLCs to develop and run methods indicating the potency and stability of pharmaceuticals.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable developing methods and debugging instrumentation independently, and passionate about maintaining the highest standards of laboratory compliance.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* BS/MS in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific discipline: relevant laboratory experience considered in lieu of degree
* Hands-on experience using HPLC instruments to analyze biologics or small molecules and develop analytical methods
* Independent, motivated, and highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
* Able to read and comprehend technical documentation including scientific literature, SOPs, and regulatory documents
* Proficient with pipetting and general lab technique
* Live within a 30 minute commute of San Carlos or willing to relocate

  

**Preferred**

* A history of using Agilent HPLC instruments for chromatogram acquisition and Agilent OpenLab software for data analysis
* Familiarity with USP, ISO, and/or GLP/GMP standards

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Develop chromatography-based analytical methods for strength and stability testing in accordance with USP guidelines. Write and review SOPs
* Analyze and interpret data; communicate findings to the lab team and recommend best course of action
* Oversee strength and stability analysis of a variety of compounds. Effectively prioritize responsibilities to maintain short and efficient turnaround times
* Manage multiple analytical instruments alongside an inventory of standards and consumables. Perform regular calibrations and ensure maximal uptime.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot problems in both assays and instrumentation. Document corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in other chemical and biochemical assays throughout the lab as needed

  

**Travel & Logistics**

Must be able to commute to the San Carlos, CA office on a consistent weekly schedule Monday-Friday.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Competitive Salary:** $100,000-$110,000 (commensurate with experience and market benchmarks)
* **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-recognized holidays
* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* **DoorDash Credit:** $25 credit for lunch and dinner while working in the office
* **401(k)** Plan with company matching, subject to plan terms
* Company-paid life insurance
* Stock option package

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You are someone who:

* Takes **full ownership of outcomes**, not just tasks
* Is highly proactive and treats every sample as if patient safety depends on it
* Thrives in structured, compliance-driven environments with zero tolerance for shortcuts
* Has meticulous attention to detail and catches errors others might miss
* Can be trusted to work independently and uphold the highest standards

  

**Application Requirements**  
Your cover letter (one page) should include clear examples of:

* A time you demonstrated exceptional work ethic
* A time you solved a difficult problem involving an HPLC or mass spec
* A time you balanced many priorities at once

  

**Life at Sapho Bio**

* **High-Impact Work:** Help transform pharmaceutical testing and accelerate patient access to life-saving therapies.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* **Financial Security:** 401(k) with company matching and company-paid life insurance.
* **Time to Recharge:** Unlimited PTO and company-recognized holidays.
* **Connection & Community:** Team lunches, office events, and offsite gatherings.
* **Competitive Compensation:** Market-leading salary and meaningful equity participation.
* **Fast-Paced Environment:** Join a team that moves quickly, learns continuously, and executes with purpose.
* **World-Class Team:** Work alongside experienced scientists, engineers, and operators.
* **Prime Location:** Sunny, collaborative workspace in San Carlos.

  

Sapho Bio is an equal employment opportunity employer. Employment is **at-will**, in accordance with California law.

jobs.title: Research Associate I
jobs.description:
**Category:**
-------------

Science

**Lab/Area:**
-------------

Bruneau Lab

**Description:**
----------------

**Who we are:**

At Gladstone Institutes, every role contributes to discoveries that have the potential to transform lives.

  

Gladstone is a world-renowned independent, nonprofit biomedical research organization dedicated to solving some of the most challenging diseases affecting humanity. Our scientists are leaders in neuroscience, cardiovascular disease, immunology, stem cell biology, and emerging areas of biomedical innovation. Located in San Francisco's vibrant Mission Bay research hub, Gladstone brings together exceptional researchers, clinicians, and professionals who share a common goal: improving human health through science.

  

With approximately 600 employees, we offer the agility of an independent institute combined with the impact of a globally recognized research organization. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are encouraged to grow professionally while contributing to work that truly matters.

  

**About the Role:**

  

The laboratory of Benoit Bruneau at the Gladstone Institutes ( http://bruneaulab.gladstone.org ) is searching for a Research Associate (RA) to help us study the regulation of genes during heart development, using mouse models in vivo and stem cells in vitro. We are looking for candidates who are strongly motivated, work well in a team, and who could start July-August 2024. There is a potential for one or two publications within a two-year time period. Candidates with plans for graduate school, medical school or dental school are encouraged to apply.

**What You Will Do:**

  

We are looking for a research associate whose primary role will focus on culturing induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) and performing molecular biology techniques to understand gene expression regulation during in vitro cardiac differentiation.

  

* iPSC culture: maintain and expand iPSC lines, including routine passaging, freezing, and thawing of cells
* Differentiation protocols: use differentiation protocols to generate cardiomyocytes, ensuring consistency and reproducibility, and checking differentiation efficiency by flow cytometry
* Molecular biology techniques: perform molecular biology techniques such as PCR, RT-qPCR, and western blotting to analyze gene expression and protein levels
* Use sequencing techniques such as RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, and ATAC-seq to investigate gene regulation and epigenetic changes in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
* Analyze experimental and sequencing data, and interpret results
* Updates records and log books and assists in maintaining lab records and inventory
Assist in lab management functions including ordering reagents, organizing laboratory inventory  

**What You Will Need:**

* Associate's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong work ethic
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to multitask
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team setting.  

**What Is Preferred:**

* BA/BS in Biological sciences and at least 6 months practical experience in a research laboratory (preferred)
* iPSC or cell culture
* Flow cytometry
* Molecular biology skills such as PCR, western blotting, RT-qPCR
* Lab management (ordering, restocking, database maintenance)
* Additional Skills
* R or python programming (or equivalent)
* Experience with next-generation sequencing, e.g., RNA-seq, ChIP-seq
* CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing
Proficiency in Excel, Word, ImageJ Fiji, Photoshop and Illustrator  

**Salary Range:**

$28.91/hr. ($60,147) - $33.32/hr. ($69,307)

**Gladstone Perks & Benefits**

* *People* –work with talented, committed, and supportive teammates within an organization that values each member of its community.
* *A meaningful place to grow and learn* –whether it’s your professional skills or scientific knowledge, we have the resources and environment to advance either so you can better support Gladstone’s mission to drive a new era of discovery in disease-oriented science and to mentor tomorrow’s leaders in an inspiring and excellent environment.
* *Healthy work/life balance* –you are highly engaged and productive at work because you can have time to recharge and enjoy a vibrant life outside of work.
* *Compensation* –competitive salary. Title and salary will be commensurate with education and experience.
* *Excellent benefits* –generous medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, paid vacation, commuter benefits, access to free shuttle transportation.

Gladstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other non-job related characteristic. We make all employment decisions so as to further this principle of equal employment.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar Research Associate
jobs.description:
A position is open for a Postdoctoral Researcher to join the research laboratory of Dr. Annie Hiniker at the University of Southern California. Dr. Hiniker is the Norman and Mary Pattiz Foundation Endowed Associate Professor in Neuropathology and Director of the USC Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center Neuropathology Core.

This NIH-funded research project is a close collaboration with Dr. Allison Kraus’s laboratory at Case Western Reserve University and will study when and where tau seeding emerges in the normal human brain and how tau seeds are modified by age, co-pathologies, inflammatory responses, and regional molecular changes. The project will combine detailed human neuropathology with RT-QuIC seeding assays (performed at the Kraus lab), biochemical characterization, transcriptomic analysis, and multiomic approaches. Applicants should hold, or soon receive, a Ph.D. in neuroscience, molecular biology, biochemistry, pathology, or a related discipline.

**Research Description**

The Hiniker lab uses human neuropathology, cell and molecular biology, and molecular profiling to identify mechanisms underlying neurodegenerative disease. Broadly, the lab focuses on protein aggregation and degradation in neurodegenerative diseases (please see our lab website). A major focus of this project is to define the distribution, biochemical features, and cellular correlates of tau seeds across aging and disease states, and to define the features of pathogenic tau seeds that drive neurodegenerative disease.

**Research Activity**

* Studies using well-characterized human brain tissue from neurodegenerative disease and control cohorts
* Neuropathologic analysis via immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence of tau, a-synuclein, TDP-43, Ab, and related changes
* Integration of neuropathology with tau RT-QuIC and related seed amplification assays
* Biochemistry and molecular biology of human brain tissue
* Generatio and analysis of multiomic (transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, and related molecular) datasets
* Preparation of manuscripts, figures, abstracts, and presentations

Salary Range:

The annual base salary range for this position is $$70,304- $80,000. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.“

Minimum Education: PhD or equivalent doctorate acquired within the previous 4 years.  
Preferred Qualifications:  
PhD or equivalent doctorate in neuroscience, molecular biology, biochemistry, pathology, or related areas:  

* Strong publication record
* Experience with neurodegenerative disease research
* Experience with transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, or related molecular datasets
